name: Greater Fireball Rune OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-09: Killer in the Golden Mask
description: An invisible rune creates an invisible, spherical magical sensor with a 20-foot radius.
disable: DC 25 Thievery (expert) to erase the rune without triggering the sensor, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract the rune

generalAbilities.name: Fireball
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature enters the sensor area

Effect The rune detonates a fireball centered on the triggering creature's square. This is a 4th-rank Fireball spell that deals 8d6 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw).
